_comment: Deliberate, reviewed differences between the baseline and a migration target. Anything not listed here fails. Each entry is a human decision with a reason, never a way to silence a failure. The first three are known limits of the suite itself (all targets). The rest are Part 2's static archive (target static), made by retire/run.sh. The baseline was re-frozen on 2026-10-25 from production after the cleanup (DISCOVERIES.md): Google Analytics, the Google Maps key and the personal-data files are gone from the original itself, so they need no entry; retire/prep/20-disable-google-analytics.sh only guards that Analytics stays off.

entries.regex: ^(.*[Ff]eel free to email|Send us an email at) \.$
entries.reason: Suite limit, not a site change: an e-mail address written by document.write() (node 3804 and the 'feel free to email' line on 19 listing and teaser pages). The HTML baseline records the line with a hole; a real browser shows the filled-in address, so the line never matches in the visible tier. Semantic still requires the line. No tier checks the address itself (DISCOVERIES.md).

Suite limit, not a site change: the tripinfo_item prev / Up / next pager is three <a> elements with no whitespace between them. The HTML extractor reads one run-together line; Drupal's book CSS shows three lines, so the visible tier never finds it whole. Semantic still requires the line and all three links. Kit gap: the extractor should split adjacent block-styled links (DISCOVERIES.md).

Suite limit, not a site change: the audio module prints a live download counter (audio.download_count) on the 10 podcast nodes and the /audio and /podcast listings, and every request to /audio/download/N/... adds one, including the suite's own asset check. The number cannot be frozen. The 'N downloads' line must still exist; its value is not compared. Pristine values are in DISCOVERIES.md.

An archive has no unpublished pages: the 81 paths of the 41 unpublished nodes answer 404 instead of Drupal's 403. Equally private. Only 403 -> 404 is allowed; a private page that leaks (403 -> 200) still fails, and a Drupal 11 target is still held to 403.

Home page only: retire/prep/10-remove-search-pane.sh removes the Search pane (heading 'Search' and the site's only form) from the home page's Panel, because search cannot work on a static site (Lullabot retirement series, part 1).

Uploaded pre-Drupal gallery page: its one link to the production domain, http://hobobiker.com/, is made relative (/) by rewrite-static.mjs so the archive does not depend on that domain. Exact text replacement; every other byte is the original's (20 bytes shorter).

Uploaded pre-Drupal gallery page: its one link to the production domain, http://hobobiker.com/mexico/, is made relative (/mexico/) by rewrite-static.mjs so the archive does not depend on that domain. Exact text replacement; every other byte is the original's (20 bytes shorter).

Node 2307 is empty in the source (no type, title, body or date; unpublished). Owner: it moves to another type (page). A Drupal 11 node must have a title to be valid data, so hobobiker-d11/scripts/40-nodes.php gives it "(no title)".

Owner: the comment on a deleted node may be dropped. Comment 27 belongs to node 1198, which no longer exists in the source, so it has nothing to attach to in Drupal 11 (a comment must reference an existing entity). hobobiker-d11/scripts/50-comments.php skips it and counts it as dropped (1).

entries.regex: ^(Fatal error: Uncaught ArgumentCountError: Too few arguments to function tripinfo_list\(\), 0 passed in /var/www/html/docroot/includes/menu\.inc on line 350 and exactly 2 expected in /var/www/html/docroot/sites/all/modules/tripinfo/tripinfo\.module:51|Stack trace:|#0 /var/www/html/docroot/includes/menu\.inc\(350\): tripinfo_list\(\)|#1 /var/www/html/docroot/index\.php\(17\): menu_execute_active_handler\(\)|#2 \{main\}|thrown in /var/www/html/docroot/sites/all/modules/tripinfo/tripinfo\.module on line 51)$
entries.reason: On the original, /tripinfo with no dates is a PHP fatal error (tripinfo_list() called without its two arguments); the page prints the error and a stack trace with server file paths. The hobobiker module's route gives the dates defaults, so the page shows the trip table for no dates instead of a crash. Exactly these 6 error lines.

The one blog photo shown through D6 imagefield's lightbox formatter (node 1313, and the lists that show it in full) links to its 600x800 copy. D6 served image derivatives at sites/default/files/imagecache/PRESET/FILE; Drupal 11 serves the same 600x800 image style at sites/default/files/styles/600x800/public/FILE. Same image, Drupal 11's path for it. The photo itself (180x240, file name compared) and its caption match.

entries.equals: content column could not be located
entries.reason: Follows the declared /tripinfo lines difference: on the original this page is a PHP fatal error with no content column; on Drupal 11 it shows the (empty) trip table, so the layout tier has no baseline column to compare.

Deliberate change (the owner's decision): node 3953's stored teaser ends inside an unclosed HTML comment ("<!--" then "<h3>New Pictures"). The original printed it as is, so browsers hid everything after it on this listing, up to the page's next "-->" (the following posts and the pager). hobobiker-d11's D6 HTML corrector (hobobiker_htmlcorrector) closes the comment at the end of the teaser, so those posts show. The suite does not report text a target adds, so this entry documents the change: it names the first post shown here that the original hid.
